recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-31743 unless search-parameter tooling later requires a different representation for text components in composite parameters.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 issue requesting a Composition composite search parameter named section-code-text that searches text within the same section identified by a section code.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied with FHIR-31880 by commit 586441a2c8, which added Composition-section-code-text to source/composition/bundle-Composition-search-params.xml. The current source retains code section-code-text, type composite, expression Composition.repeat(section), and components section.code and section.text.
additional_context: FHIR-31880 is the companion section-text request and supplies the text component. SDWG May 2021 minutes confirm approval of FHIR-31743. The Zulip thread that led to the Jira issues specifically suggested Composition.section-code-text for code and text in the same section. Later FHIR-49784 updated the base expression to Composition.repeat(section) for recursive sections.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build-scoped source already satisfies the same-section composite search request.

related_jiras.note: Companion request for section-text, implemented in the same historical source commit and needed as this composite parameter's text component.
Later recursive search-parameter update changed the composite base expression to Composition.repeat(section) without reversing the same-section semantics.
